translations.literal: The Pasha took poison and died; his son Berkehuli killed his younger brother and fled to Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: The Pasha took poison and died. His son Berkehuli killed his brother and fled to Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 白彥虎走開都河，宗棠欲遂擒之，奏未上，適庫倫大臣上言西事宜畫定疆界，而廷臣亦謂西征費鉅，今烏城、吐魯番既得，可休兵。

translations.literal: Bai Yanhu fled toward the Kaidu River; Zongtang wished to capture him at once; his memorial had not yet gone up when it happened that the Urga minister memorialized that western affairs should fix boundaries, and court ministers also said the western expedition cost heavily and now that Wucheng and Turfan were gained, the army could rest.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Yanhu fled toward the Kaidu River. Zongtang wanted to pursue him immediately, but before his memorial reached the throne the Urga minister urged fixing the western border, and court officials argued that with Urumqi and Turfan recovered the costly western campaign could stop.

sentences.zh: 宗棠歎曰：「今時有可乘，乃為畫地縮守之策乎？」

translations.literal: Zongtang sighed and said: "Now when the moment can be seized, shall we adopt a policy of drawing boundaries and shrinking defense?"
translations.idiomatic: Zongtang sighed: "When the moment is ripe, are we to adopt a policy of drawing boundaries and shrinking our hold?"

sentences.zh: 抗疏爭之，上以為然。

translations.literal: He submitted a defiant memorial disputing this; the throne held him correct.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a forceful dissent, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 時俄方與土耳其戰，金順請乘虛襲伊犁。

translations.literal: At that time Russia was at war with Turkey; Jin Shun requested taking advantage of the opening to raid Yili.
translations.idiomatic: Russia was then at war with Turkey, and Jin Shun urged a surprise attack on Yili.

sentences.zh: 宗棠曰：「不可。

translations.literal: Zongtang said: "This cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: Zongtang said, "That will not do.

sentences.zh: 師不以正，彼有辭矣。」

translations.literal: If the army is not righteous in its conduct, they will have grounds for complaint."
translations.idiomatic: If our army is not just in its conduct, they will have grounds against us."

sentences.zh: 八月，錦棠會師曲會，遂由大道向開都河為正兵，餘虎恩等奇兵出庫爾。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Jintang assembled troops at Quhui, then along the main road toward the Kaidu River as the main force, while Yu Hu'en and others as flanking troops went out through Korla.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Jintang assembled at Quhui. The main column marched on the Kaidu River while Yu Hu'en led a flanking force through Korla.

sentences.zh: 白彥虎走庫車，趨阿克蘇，錦棠遮擊之，轉遁喀什噶爾。

translations.literal: Bai Yanhu fled to Kuche, hurried toward Aksu; Jintang intercepted and struck him; he turned and fled to Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Yanhu fled to Kuche and Aksu. Jintang intercepted him and drove him toward Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 大軍還定烏什，遂收南疆東四城，何步雲以喀什漢城降。

translations.literal: The great army returned to settle Wushi, then recovered the four eastern cities of southern Xinjiang; He Buyun surrendered the Han city of Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: The main army secured Wushi and recovered the four eastern cities of the south. He Buyun surrendered the Han quarter of Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 伯克胡里既納白彥虎，乃效力攻漢城。

translations.literal: Berkehuli, having taken in Bai Yanhu, then exerted his strength to attack the Han city.
translations.idiomatic: Berkehuli, having taken in Bai Yanhu, threw his forces against the Han quarter.

sentences.zh: 大軍至，复遁走俄。

translations.literal: When the great army arrived, he again fled in disorder to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived, he fled again into Russian territory.

sentences.zh: 西四城相繼下，宗棠露布以聞，詔晉二等侯。

translations.literal: The four western cities were taken in succession; Zongtang announced victory in a bulletin; an edict promoted him to second-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: The four western cities fell in succession. Zongtang announced victory, and the court promoted him to second-class marquis.

sentences.zh: 布魯特十四部爭內附。

translations.literal: The fourteen Kirghiz tribes competed to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Kirghiz tribes competed to submit to the empire.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，條上新疆建行省事宜，並請與俄議還伊犁、交叛人二事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, he itemized memorializing on establishing a province in Xinjiang, and also requested negotiating with Russia on returning Yili and handing over rebels—two matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of 1878 he memorialized on establishing provincial government in Xinjiang and on negotiating with Russia for the return of Yili and the extradition of rebels.

sentences.zh: 詔遣全權大臣崇厚使俄。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched plenipotentiary minister Chong Hou as envoy to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: The court dispatched plenipotentiary Chong Hou to Russia.

sentences.zh: 俄以通商、分界、償款三端相要。

translations.literal: Russia demanded three points: trade, boundary demarcation, and indemnity.
translations.idiomatic: Russia demanded concessions on trade, boundaries, and indemnity.

sentences.zh: 崇厚遽定約，為朝士所糾，議久不決。

translations.literal: Chong Hou hastily fixed a treaty; he was impeached by court scholars; deliberation long remained unresolved.
translations.idiomatic: Chong Hou hastily signed a treaty, was impeached by the court, and debate dragged on unresolved.

sentences.zh: 宗棠奏曰：「自俄踞伊犁，蠶食不已，新疆乃有日蹙百里之勢。

translations.literal: Zongtang memorialized, saying: "Since Russia occupied Yili and has nibbled away without cease, Xinjiang has had the momentum of shrinking a hundred li day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Zongtang memorialized: "Since Russia seized Yili it has nibbled away without cease, and Xinjiang has been shrinking day by day.

sentences.zh: 俄視伊犁為外府，及我索地，則索償盧布五百萬元。

translations.literal: Russia regards Yili as an outer prefecture; when we demand the territory back, it demands five million rubles in compensation.
translations.idiomatic: Russia treats Yili as an outer dependency and demands five million rubles when we ask for its return.

sentences.zh: 是俄還伊犁，於俄無損，我得伊犁，僅一荒郊。

translations.literal: Thus for Russia to return Yili is no loss to Russia; for us to gain Yili is only a barren outskirts.
translations.idiomatic: Returning Yili costs Russia nothing; receiving it gives us only a wasteland.

sentences.zh: 今崇厚又議畀俄陬爾果斯河及帖克斯河，是劃伊犁西南之地歸俄也。

translations.literal: Now Chong Hou further negotiated ceding to Russia the Ili and Tekes rivers—this is to mark off southwestern Yili territory for Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Now Chong Hou would also cede the Ili and Tekes rivers, handing southwestern Yili to Russia.

sentences.zh: 武事不競之秋，有割地求和者矣。

translations.literal: In seasons when military affairs are not competitive, there have been those who ceded territory to seek peace.
translations.idiomatic: In ages when China could not compete militarily, rulers ceded land for peace.

sentences.zh: 茲一矢未加，遽捐要地，此界務之不可許者也。

translations.literal: Now without a single arrow loosed, urgently to surrender vital ground—this boundary affair absolutely cannot be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: To surrender vital ground without firing a shot is a boundary settlement that cannot be accepted.

sentences.zh: 俄商志在貿易，其政府即廣設領事，欲藉通商深入腹地，此商務之不可許者也。

translations.literal: Russian merchants aim at trade; their government broadly establishes consuls, wishing through trade to penetrate deep into the interior—this commercial affair absolutely cannot be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Russian merchants seek trade, but their government uses consulates to penetrate the interior through commerce. That too cannot be accepted.

sentences.zh: 臣維俄人包藏禍心，妄忖吾國或厭用兵，遂以全權之使臣牽制疆臣。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that Russians harbor evil intent, recklessly surmising our state may be weary of using troops, and therefore use a plenipotentiary envoy to restrain frontier ministers.
translations.idiomatic: I believe the Russians harbor malicious intent, assuming China is weary of war and using a plenipotentiary to restrain our frontier commanders.

sentences.zh: 為今之計，當先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝。

translations.literal: For the present plan, one should first use argument, tactful and employing stratagem; next decide by battle array, enduring firmly and seeking victory.
translations.idiomatic: The present plan should begin with diplomacy, tactful and resourceful, and if need be decide the issue on the battlefield with patient resolve.

sentences.zh: 臣雖衰慵無似，敢不勉旃。」

translations.literal: Your servant, though decrepit and indolent beyond compare, dares not fail to exert himself."
translations.idiomatic: Though I am old and feeble, I shall not fail to do my utmost."

sentences.zh: 上壯其言，嘉許之。

translations.literal: The throne was heartened by his words and praised him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was heartened and praised him.

sentences.zh: 崇厚得罪去，命曾紀澤使俄，更前約。

translations.literal: Chong Hou was dismissed for his offense; Zeng Jize was ordered as envoy to Russia to revise the earlier treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Chong Hou was dismissed and Zeng Jize was sent to Russia to revise the treaty.

sentences.zh: 於是宗棠乃自請出屯哈密，規复伊犁。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zongtang himself requested to go out and garrison Hami, planning to recover Yili.
translations.idiomatic: Zongtang then volunteered to garrison Hami and prepare to recover Yili.

sentences.zh: 以金順出精河為東路，張曜沿特克斯河為中路，錦棠經布魯特游牧為西路；

translations.literal: Jin Shun was sent out along Jinghe as the eastern route, Zhang Yao along the Tekes River as the central route, Jintang through Kirghiz nomad lands as the western route;
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun took the eastern route from Jinghe, Zhang Yao the central route along the Tekes, and Jintang the western route through Kirghiz lands;

sentences.zh: 而分遣譚上連等分屯喀什噶爾、阿克蘇、哈密為後路聲援：合馬步卒四萬餘人。

translations.literal: while Tan Shanglian and others were separately dispatched to garrison Kashgar, Aksu, and Hami as rear-route support: in all more than forty thousand cavalry and infantry.
translations.idiomatic: while Tan Shanglian and others garrisoned Kashgar, Aksu, and Hami as rear support, for a total of more than forty thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，宗棠輿櫬發肅州，五月，抵哈密。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year, Zongtang set out from Suzhou with his coffin in the train; in the fifth month he reached Hami.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1880 Zongtang left Suzhou with a coffin in his train, symbolizing his resolve to die there if need be. He reached Hami in the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 俄聞王師大出，增兵守伊犁、納林河，別以兵船翔海上，用震撼京師，同時天津、奉天、山東皆警。

translations.literal: Russia, hearing the imperial army was coming out in force, increased troops to guard Yili and the Nalin River, and separately sent warships cruising at sea to shake the capital; at the same time Tianjin, Fengtian, and Shandong were all on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Russia, hearing of the mass mobilization, reinforced Yili and the Nalin River and sent warships along the coast to intimidate Beijing. Tianjin, Fengtian, and Shandong all went on alert.

sentences.zh: 七月，詔宗棠入都備顧問，以錦棠代之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, an edict ordered Zongtang into the capital to serve as adviser; Jintang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the court recalled Zongtang to the capital as adviser and left Jintang in command.

sentences.zh: 而俄亦懾我兵威，恐事​​遂決裂。

translations.literal: Russia also feared our military might and dreaded that affairs would break off decisively.
translations.idiomatic: Russia also feared China's military strength and dreaded a complete break.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，和議成，交還伊犁，防海軍皆罷。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded, Yili was handed back, and coastal defense fleets were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The following first month a treaty was concluded, Yili was returned, and the coastal defense fleets were stood down.

sentences.zh: 宗棠用兵善審機，不常其方略。

translations.literal: Zongtang in using troops was skilled at weighing opportunity and did not fix his strategy.
translations.idiomatic: In warfare Zongtang was skilled at seizing opportunity and never clung to a fixed plan.

sentences.zh: 籌西事，尤以節兵裕餉為本謀。

translations.literal: In planning western affairs, he especially took economizing troops and enriching provisions as his fundamental scheme.
translations.idiomatic: In planning the western campaigns his fundamental aim was to economize troops and secure supplies.

sentences.zh: 始西征，慮各行省協助餉不時至，請一借貸外國。

translations.literal: At the start of the western expedition, fearing that assistance funds from the various provinces would not arrive in time, he requested a single foreign loan.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the western expedition, fearing provincial subsidies would arrive late, he requested a foreign loan.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨尼其議，詔曰：「宗棠以西事自任，國家何惜千萬金。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen obstructed this proposal; an edict said: "Zongtang has taken western affairs upon himself; what would the state begrudge of ten million in gold?
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen opposed the idea. An edict replied: "Zongtang has taken the western campaign upon himself. Why should the state begrudge ten million taels?

sentences.zh: 為撥款五百萬，敕自借外國債五百萬。」

translations.literal: Five million was allocated, and he was ordered himself to borrow five million in foreign debt."
translations.idiomatic: Five million was allocated from the treasury, and he was authorized to borrow another five million abroad."

sentences.zh: 出塞凡二十月，而新疆南北城盡复者，饋運饒給之力也。

translations.literal: Going beyond the passes altogether twenty months, yet recovering all cities north and south in Xinjiang—this was the power of abundant supply transport.
translations.idiomatic: In twenty months beyond the passes he recovered every city in Xinjiang north and south, thanks above all to abundant logistics.

sentences.zh: 初議西事，主興屯田，聞者迂之；

translations.literal: When western affairs were first discussed, he advocated establishing military colonies; hearers regarded this as impractical;
translations.idiomatic: When western policy was first debated, his advocacy of military colonies seemed impractical;

sentences.zh: 及觀宗棠奏論關內外舊屯之弊，以謂掛名兵籍，不得更事農，宜畫兵農為二，簡精壯為兵，散願弱使屯墾，然後人服其老謀。

translations.literal: but after reading Zongtang's memorial analyzing the defects of old colonies inside and outside the passes, holding that men nominally on military rolls could not again work as farmers, soldiers and farmers should be divided into two categories, selecting the strong for troops and dispersing the willing weak to colonize and reclaim land—then people submitted to his seasoned planning.
translations.idiomatic: but after reading his analysis of the old garrison-colony system, which kept men on the rolls from farming, his plan to separate soldiers and colonists, keep the strong under arms, and settle the willing weak on the land won general respect for his seasoned judgment.

sentences.zh: 既入覲，賜紫禁城騎馬，使內侍二人扶掖上殿，授軍機大臣，兼值譯署。

translations.literal: After entering audience, he was granted riding in the Forbidden City, two inner attendants were made to support him up the hall, he was appointed Grand Councilor, and concurrently served in the Translation Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: After his audience he was granted the privilege of riding in the Forbidden City, helped up the hall by two eunuchs, appointed to the Grand Council, and given charge of the Translation Bureau.

sentences.zh: 國家承平久，武備弛不振，而海外諸國爭言富強，雖中國屢平大難，彼猶私議以為脆弱也。

translations.literal: The state had long enjoyed peace, military preparations were lax and not revived, while overseas nations all spoke of wealth and strength; although China repeatedly pacified great calamities, they still privately discussed it as fragile.
translations.idiomatic: After long peace China's military preparations had lapsed, while foreign powers boasted of their strength. Though China had suppressed major rebellions, foreigners still whispered that it was weak.

sentences.zh: 及宗棠平帕夏，外國乃稍稍傳說之。

translations.literal: After Zongtang pacified the Pasha, foreign countries then gradually spread word of it.
translations.idiomatic: Only after Zongtang destroyed the Pasha did foreign countries begin to spread word of China's power.

sentences.zh: 其初入京師，內城有教堂高樓，俯瞰宮殿，民間讙言左侯至，樓即毀矣，為示諭曉，乃止。

translations.literal: When he first entered the capital, in the inner city there was a church tall tower overlooking the palace; the populace clamored that when Marquis Zuo arrived, the tower would be destroyed; an edict was issued to clarify, and then it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When he first entered Beijing, rumor spread that the tall church overlooking the palace would be torn down as soon as Marquis Zuo arrived. An official clarification ended the talk.

sentences.zh: 其威望在人如此。

translations.literal: His prestige among the people was such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Such was his prestige among the people.

sentences.zh: 然值軍機、譯署，同列頗厭苦之。

translations.literal: Yet when he served in the Grand Council and Translation Bureau, his colleagues were quite wearied and troubled by him.
translations.idiomatic: Yet on the Grand Council and in the Translation Bureau his colleagues found him burdensome.

sentences.zh: 宗棠亦自不樂居內，引疾乞退。

translations.literal: Zongtang also himself was not happy dwelling within; citing illness he begged to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Zongtang himself was unhappy in the capital and pleaded illness to retire.

sentences.zh: 九月，出為兩江總督、南洋通商大臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, he went out as governor-general of the Two Jiangs and Minister of Southern Ocean Trade.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was appointed governor-general of Jiangsu and Jiangxi and Minister of Southern Ocean Trade.

sentences.zh: 嘗出巡吳淞，過上海，西人為建龍旗，聲砲，迎導之維謹。

translations.literal: He once went out on inspection to Wusong, passed Shanghai; Westerners raised dragon flags for him, fired salutes, and received and guided him with utmost propriety.
translations.idiomatic: On an inspection tour to Wusong he passed through Shanghai, where Westerners raised dragon flags, fired salutes, and received him with elaborate ceremony.

sentences.zh: 九年，法人攻越南，自請赴滇督師。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the French attacked Vietnam; he volunteered to go to Yunnan to direct the army.
translations.idiomatic: In 1883, when France attacked Vietnam, he volunteered to command in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 檄故吏王德榜募軍永州，號「恪靖定邊軍」，法旋議和，止其行。

translations.literal: He ordered his former subordinate Wang Debang to recruit troops at Yongzhou, styled the Kejing Pacify-the-Border Army; France soon negotiated peace, and his march was halted.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Wang Debang to raise the Kejing Pacify-the-Border Army at Yongzhou, but peace talks soon halted his march.

sentences.zh: 十年，滇、越邊軍潰，召入都，再直軍機。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the Yunnan-Vietnam border army collapsed; he was summoned to the capital and again served directly in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In 1884, after the Yunnan-Vietnam border army collapsed, he was recalled to the capital and rejoined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 法大舉內犯，詔宗棠視師福建，檄王珍子詩正潛軍渡台灣，號「恪靖援台軍」。

translations.literal: France launched a major invasion inland; an edict ordered Zongtang to inspect the army in Fujian; he ordered Wang Zhen's son Shizheng to lead troops secretly across to Taiwan, styled the Kejing Aid-Taiwan Army.
translations.idiomatic: When France invaded on a large scale, Zongtang was ordered to command in Fujian and sent Wang Zhen's son Shizheng with the Kejing Aid-Taiwan Army to cross secretly to Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 詩正至台南，為法兵所阻，而德榜會諸軍大捷於諒山。

translations.literal: Shizheng reached Tainan but was blocked by French troops; meanwhile Debang joined the various armies in a great victory at Lang Son.
translations.idiomatic: Shizheng reached Tainan but was blocked by the French, while Debang won a great victory at Lang Son with the combined armies.

sentences.zh: 和議成，再引疾乞退。

translations.literal: When peace was concluded, he again cited illness and begged to retire.
translations.idiomatic: When peace was concluded he again pleaded illness to retire.

sentences.zh: 七月，卒於福州，年七十三，贈太傅，諡文襄。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, he died at Fuzhou, age seventy-three; posthumously given Grand Tutor, posthumous name Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he died at Fuzhou at the age of seventy-three. He was posthumously made Grand Tutor and given the posthumous name Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 祀京師昭忠祠、賢良祠，並建專祠於湖南及立功諸省。

translations.literal: He was enshrined in the capital's Shrine of Manifest Loyalty and Shrine of Worthy Officials, and dedicated shrines were also built in Hunan and the provinces where he achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: He was enshrined in the Manifest Loyalty and Worthy Officials shrines in the capital, and dedicated shrines were built in Hunan and every province where he had won distinction.

sentences.zh: 宗棠為人多智略，內行甚篤，剛峻自天性。

translations.literal: Zongtang as a man possessed much strategy and resourcefulness, his private conduct was very sincere, and stern severity came from his nature.
translations.idiomatic: Zongtang was resourceful and shrewd, deeply sincere in private life, and stern by nature.

sentences.zh: 穆宗嘗戒其褊衷。

translations.literal: The Muzong Emperor once admonished him for narrow-mindedness.
translations.idiomatic: The Tongzhi Emperor once warned him against narrow-mindedness.

sentences.zh: 始未出，與國籓、林翼交，氣陵二人出其上。

translations.literal: Before he had come forth, in association with Guofan and Linyi, his spirit overbore the two and stood above them.
translations.idiomatic: Before he entered service, in his dealings with Guofan and Linyi his bearing dominated theirs.

sentences.zh: 中興諸將帥，大率國籓所薦起，雖貴，皆尊事國籓。

translations.literal: The generals and commanders of the restoration were mostly raised through Guofan's recommendations; though honored, all revered and served Guofan.
translations.idiomatic: Most restoration commanders had been raised through Guofan's recommendation and, however exalted, treated him with deference.

sentences.zh: 宗棠獨與抗行，不少屈，趣舍時合時不合。

translations.literal: Zongtang alone matched him as an equal, yielding little; their inclinations sometimes agreed and sometimes did not.
translations.idiomatic: Zongtang alone stood as his equal and rarely yielded. Their views sometimes agreed and sometimes clashed.

sentences.zh: 國籓以學問自斂抑，議外交常持和節；

translations.literal: Guofan restrained himself through learning, and in discussing foreign relations usually held to conciliatory moderation;
translations.idiomatic: Guofan restrained himself through scholarship and usually favored conciliation in foreign affairs;

sentences.zh: 宗棠鋒穎凜凜向敵矣，士論以此益附之。

translations.literal: Zongtang's sharp edge was awe-inspiring toward the enemy; public opinion for this reason attached to him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Zongtang's sharp edge was turned unflinchingly against the enemy, and public opinion rallied to him for it.

sentences.zh: 然好自矜伐，故出其門者，成德達材不及國籓之盛雲。

translations.literal: Yet he loved to boast of himself, and therefore those who came from his gate in accomplished virtue and eminent talent did not reach the abundance of Guofan's followers.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he loved self-praise, and those who came from his school in virtue and talent never matched the abundance of Guofan's followers.

sentences.zh: 子四人：孝威，舉人，以廕為主事，先卒，旌表孝行；

translations.literal: He had four sons: Xiaowei, a provincial graduate, who through yin privilege became a director and died first, with filial conduct publicly honored;
translations.idiomatic: He had four sons: Xiaowei, a provincial graduate who entered office by yin privilege, died before his father, and was honored for filial conduct;

sentences.zh: 孝寬，郎中；

translations.literal: Xiaokuan, a director;
translations.idiomatic: Xiaokuan, a director in the Ministry of Rites;

sentences.zh: 孝勳，兵部主事；

translations.literal: Xiaoxun, a director in the Ministry of War;
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoxun, a director in the Ministry of War;

sentences.zh: 孝同，江蘇提法使。

translations.literal: Xiaotong, Jiangsu judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaotong, judicial commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 孫念謙，襲侯爵，通政司副使。

translations.literal: His grandson Nianqian inherited the marquisate and served as vice commissioner of the Court of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Nianqian inherited the marquisate and served as vice commissioner of the Court of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 論曰：「宗棠事功著矣，其志行忠介，亦有過人。

translations.literal: The commentator says: "Zongtang's achievements are illustrious; his will and conduct are loyal and upright, and also surpass ordinary men.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator writes: "Zongtang's achievements are illustrious, and his loyal, upright character also surpasses ordinary men.

sentences.zh: 廉不言貧，勤不言勞。

translations.literal: In integrity he did not speak of poverty; in diligence he did not speak of toil.
translations.idiomatic: He did not speak of his poverty, nor boast of his labor.

sentences.zh: 待將士以誠信相感。

translations.literal: He treated officers and soldiers by moving them with sincerity and trust.
translations.idiomatic: He won officers and soldiers through sincerity and trust.

sentences.zh: 善於治民，每克一地，招徠撫綏，眾至如歸。

translations.literal: He was skilled at governing the people; whenever he captured a place, he recruited, comforted, and pacified, and the masses came as if returning home.
translations.idiomatic: He excelled at governing civilians. Whenever he took a place he recruited settlers, comforted the people, and made them feel at home.

sentences.zh: 論者謂宗棠有霸才，而治民則以王道行之，信哉。

translations.literal: Discussants say Zongtang had hegemonic talent, yet in governing the people he applied the kingly way—truly so.
translations.idiomatic: Critics say he had the talent of a hegemon but ruled the people by the kingly way. That is surely true.

sentences.zh: 宗棠初出治軍，胡林翼為書告湖南曰：「左公不顧家，請歲籌三百六十金以贍其私。」

translations.literal: When Zongtang first came forth to manage the army, Hu Linyi wrote informing Hunan: "Lord Zuo does not care for his household; please arrange three hundred sixty taels yearly to support his private needs."
translations.idiomatic: When Zongtang first took command, Hu Linyi wrote to Hunan: "Lord Zuo neglects his household. Please set aside three hundred sixty taels a year for his private needs."

sentences.zh: 曾國籓見其所居幕★C7小，為別制二幕貽之，其廉儉若此。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan saw that the quarters where he lived were small, had two separate quarters specially made and presented to him—such was his integrity and frugality.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan saw how small his quarters were and had two new ones made for him as a gift. Such was his integrity and frugality.

sentences.zh: 初與國籓論事不洽，及聞其薨，乃曰：「謀國之忠，知人之明，自媿不如。」

translations.literal: At first in discussing affairs with Guofan he was not in accord; when he heard of Guofan's death, he then said: "Loyalty in planning for the state, clarity in knowing men—I am ashamed to say I do not measure up."
translations.idiomatic: He had often clashed with Guofan in council. When he heard of Guofan's death he said, "In loyalty to the state and discernment of men, I am ashamed to say I do not measure up."

sentences.zh: 志益遠矣。

translations.literal: His ambition grew ever more far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: His vision had grown ever broader.
